request.system: You are a fraud analytics feature engineer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Existing provider features are grouped into families below. Propose new provider-level features that describe HOW a provider bills rather than HOW MUCH, because claim volume already explains most of the label. Use only the claim columns and provider bases the schema allows. Never use the label. (Independent run 2.)

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_reimb_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Dispersion of inpatient payments shows uniform or templated billing versus a natural case mix.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_reimb_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient payment variability is a pattern signal that is independent of volume.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_los_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Length-of-stay spread can reveal formulaic admissions.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_ndiag_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Low variation in diagnosis counts suggests templated coding.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_ndiag_mean
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient diagnosis depth may indicate upcoding.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_ndiag_max
claim_aggregates.rationale: Extreme outpatient coding breadth flags padded claims.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_nproc_share
claim_aggregates.rationale: The fraction of inpatient claims with a procedure shows how procedure-heavy the billing is.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_dup_any_mean
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient duplicate billing rate across providers.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_all_dup_same_pos
claim_aggregates.rationale: The share of claims duplicated within the same provider is a direct resubmission signal.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_age_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Narrow age spread suggests a narrow or targeted patient pool.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_all_chronic_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Patient-complexity spread differentiates natural from curated populations.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_att_is_op
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient claims where the attending physician is also the operating physician show role concentration.

ratios.name: agent_bene_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Low patient breadth per claim means repeated billing on the same patients.

ratios.name: agent_oper_per_ip
ratios.rationale: Operating physician spread per inpatient claim.

ratios.name: agent_dgc_per_ip
ratios.rationale: Breadth of diagnosis group codes per inpatient claim indicates coding variety.

ratios.name: agent_states_per_bene
ratios.rationale: Geographic spread of patients relative to patient count.
